commands.name: show-access-rulebase
commands.description: Shows the entire Access Rules layer. This layer is divided into sections. An Access Rule may be within a section, or independent of a section (in which case it is said to be under the "global" section). The reply features a list of objects. Each object may be a section of the layer, with all its rules in, or a rule itself, for the case of rules which are under the global section. An optional "filter" field may be added in order to filter out only those rules that match a search criteria.

commands.name: cme-api
commands.description: CME is a utility that runs on Check Point's Security Management Server and Multi-Domain Servers running Gaia OS. CME allows cloud native integration between Check Point CloudGuard Network solutions and Cloud platforms. For more information, see the CME Administration Guide. This Management API allow you to control and configure the CME utility that is deployed on the Management Server. Use this format to execute CME API requests: Web Services syntax: <HTTP-Method> https://<mgmt-server>:<port>/web_api/cme-api/<cme-api-version>/<cme-command> mgmt_cli syntax: mgmt_cli cme-api/<cme-api-version>/<cme-command> --method <HTTP-Method> <HTTP-Method> - It is possible to use either POST, GET, DELETE or PUT based on the API documentation below. <cme-api-version> - Optional parameter. The specific version of CME API to use (such as 'v1'). Note: the latest version is used by default. <cme-command> - The CME API command that you want to use. For all available commands, see below. For a description of all CME API commands and versions and end-to-end examples, see the CME API Documentation in SwaggerHub. Note: CME-API is supported from CME take 139 and higher.

commands.name: vsx-provisioning-tool
commands.description: Run the VSX provisioning tool with the specified parameters. Important note: An automatic session publish is part of all the operations in this API.

requiredFields.name: operation
requiredFields.description: The name of the provisioning operation to run. Each operation has its own specific parameters. The available operations are:add-vsx-gateway - Adds a new VSX gatewayadd-vsx-cluster - Adds a new VSX cluster*add-vsx-cluster-member - Adds a new VSX cluster member*add-vd - Adds a new Virtual Device (VS/VSB/VSW/VR) to a VSX gateway or VSX clusteradd-vd-interface - Adds a new virtual interface to a Virtual Deviceadd-physical-interface - Adds a physical interface to a VSX gateway or VSX clusteradd-route - Adds a route to a Virtual Deviceattach-bridge - Attaches a bridge interface to a Virtual Systemremove-vsx - Removes a VSX gateway or VSX clusterremove-vd - Removes a Virtual Deviceremove-vd-interface - Removes an interface from a Virtual Deviceremove-physical-interface - Removes a physical interface from a VSX gateway or VSX clusterremove-route - Removes a route from a Virtual Deviceset-vd - Modifies a Virtual Deviceset-vd-interface - Modifies an interface on a Virtual Deviceset-physical-interface - Modifies a physical interface on a VSX cluster or VSX gateway * When adding a VSX Cluster, you must also add at least 2 cluster members * Adding cluster members is only allowed when adding a new VSX cluster * To add members to an existing cluster, use vsx-run-operation.

optionalFields.name: add-physical-interface-params
optionalFields.description: Parameters for the operation to add a physical interface to a VSX gateway or VSX Cluster.

optionalFields.name: add-route-params
optionalFields.description: Parameters for the operation to add a route to a Virtual System or Virtual Router.

optionalFields.name: add-vd-interface-params
optionalFields.description: Parameters for the operation to add a new interface to a Virtual Device.

optionalFields.name: add-vd-params
optionalFields.description: Parameters for the operation to add a new Virtual Device (VS/VSB/VSW/VR).

optionalFields.name: add-vsx-cluster-params
optionalFields.description: Parameters for the operation to add a new VSX Cluster.

optionalFields.name: add-vsx-gateway-params
optionalFields.description: Parameters for the operation to add a new VSX Gateway.

optionalFields.name: attach-bridge-params
optionalFields.description: Parameters for the operation to attach a new bridge interface to a Virtual System.

optionalFields.name: remove-physical-interface-params
optionalFields.description: Parameters for the operation to remove a physical interface from a VSX (Gateway or Cluster).

optionalFields.name: remove-route-params
optionalFields.description: Parameters for the operation to remove a route from a Virtual System or Virtual Router.

optionalFields.name: remove-vd-interface-params
optionalFields.description: Parameters for the operation to remove a logical interface from a Virtual Device.

optionalFields.name: remove-vd-params
optionalFields.description: Parameters for the operation to remove a Virtual Device.

optionalFields.name: remove-vsx-params
optionalFields.description: Parameters for the operation to remove a VSX Gateway or VSX Cluster.

optionalFields.name: set-physical-interface-params
optionalFields.description: Parameters for the operation to change the configuration of a physical interface.

optionalFields.name: set-vd-interface-params
optionalFields.description: Parameters for the operation to change the configuration of a logical interface.

optionalFields.name: set-vd-params
optionalFields.description: Parameters for the operation to change the configuration of a Virtual Device.

commands.name: vsx-run-operation
commands.description: Run the VSX operation by its name and parameters. Important note: An automatic session publish is part of all the operations in this API.

requiredFields.name: operation
requiredFields.description: The name of the operation to run. Each operation has its specific parameters. The available operations are:upgrade - Upgrades the VSX Gateway or VSX Cluster object to a higher versiondowngrade - Downgrades the VSX Gateway or VSX Cluster object to a lower versionadd-member - Adds a new VSX Cluster member objectremove-member - Removes a VSX Cluster member objectreconf-gw - Reconfigures a VSX Gateway after a clean installreconf-member - Reconfigures a VSX Cluster member after a clean install.

optionalFields.name: add-member-params
optionalFields.description: Parameters for the operation to add a VSX Cluster member.

optionalFields.name: downgrade-params
optionalFields.description: Parameters for the operation to downgrade a VSX Gateway or VSX Cluster object to a lower version. In case the current version is already the target version, or is lower than the target version, no change is done.

optionalFields.name: reconf-gw-params
optionalFields.description: Parameters for the operation to reconfigure a VSX Gateway after a clean install.

optionalFields.name: reconf-member-params
optionalFields.description: Parameters for the operation to reconfigure a VSX Cluster member after a clean install.

optionalFields.name: remove-member-params
optionalFields.description: Parameters for the operation to remove a VSX Cluster member object.

optionalFields.name: upgrade-params
optionalFields.description: Parameters for the operation to upgrade a VSX Gateway or VSX Cluster object to a higher version. In case the current version is already the target version, or is higher than the target version, no change is done.
